name: demote tasks that use their whole quantum
mechanism: keep several ready queues of increasing quantum and decreasing priority; a task that uses its whole slice drops a level, one that blocks early stays or rises, so interactive tasks stay responsive without knowing service times

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Multi level feedback queue' in section Operating systems algorithms / Scheduling:

fails_when: gaming by yielding just before the slice ends; starvation without periodic boosts
